svg.title: When Terms Blur
svg.desc: A performable score for three people. Before beginning, they choose how each person can pause or leave and what will signal uncertainty. If terms become unclear, the event stops without anyone having to remember or explain the agreement. Any new event begins with fresh terms and choices.
svg.text: RILL / A ROOM READ BY LISTENING
A SCORE FOR THREE PEOPLE TO SHAPE BEFORE BEGINNING

text.tspan: Choose a small event together, or choose none.
Together, agree how each person may pause or leave,
and how you will recognize that signal.
If a term is unclear or unusable, change it or do not begin.
No one has to remember, explain, or defend
The event is over. No record or report is due.
A new event begins only with fresh terms and choices.

svg.text: Composed score; unperformed and not shaped with participants. No access outcome is claimed.
